y.md): ARCHIVES rather than deletes, and the response says so. Existing runs keep pointing at the definition they executed, so the
ir history stays readable.\n- [Update a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-journey.md): Editing a goal
never disturbs a run already under way: a run pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.\n- [List swarms](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-swarms.md)\n- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-
swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring container holding DEFAULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts nothing.\n- [Get a
swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-swarm.md)\n- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swa
rms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the container. The goals authored under it are not touched: they keep their own definitions and
stay launchable.\n- [Update a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Changes the container's DEFA
ULTS. Goals already authored under it keep the values they were created with: this is not a cascade.\n- [List journeys](https://do
cs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-journeys.md): The project's goals, newest first. Archived goals are excluded.\n- [Create a
journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona pursuing a task against o
ne or more environments. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/generate`: that route persists
nothing.\n- [List secrets](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/list-secrets.md): The project's credentials as METADATA
ONLY: no value is returned by this or any other route. Shows the project-shared secrets plus the caller's own personal ones; anoth
er member's personal secret does not appear at all, not even its name.\n- [Create a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
secrets/create-a-secret.md): Store a credential so environments can grant it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE REQUEST BODY and be
comes visible to whatever makes the call. The response is metadata only. Creating a project-shared secret requires project admin;
a personal one does not.\n- [Get a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.md): One secret's metadata:
delivery mode, host binding, sharing, and when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from another project (and an
other member's personal secret) both read as 404.\n- [Delete a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/delete-a-secr
et.md): Delete a stored credential. HARD: the row and the encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops delivering it. Deliberately NO
T blocked when an environment still selects it: refusing would leave a leaked credential undeletable until someone edited every en
vironment naming it, and deletion must never wai…\n- [Rotate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/ro
tate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the value and/or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUNS ONLY: a session alre
ady running holds the old value (materialized in its box's environment, or inside an egress policy that cannot be read back) and t
here is no safe way to replace it mid-run.\n- [List a journey's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-jour
neys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact records: `attempts` is on the single-run read.\n- [Launch a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/
api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journey.md): Answers **202**: the run row exists and its fan-out has started. It is not finished
. Poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-runs/{runId}` until `status` leaves `running`.\n- [Get a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journey-run.md): The full record, including per-session `attempts` and `targetSummaries`.\n- [Li
st a run's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-runs-sessions.md): One entry per chat session the run
produced. Summaries, not transcripts. Read a transcript through the chat-session routes using `id`.\n- [Cancel a journey run](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop request and returns immediately. cl
eanupPending indicates that attempts are being settled in the background; status remains the current stored run status. IDEMPOTENT
: cancelling an already-cancelled run answers 200 with `alreadyCanceled: true` and `finalized: 0`, not a 409.\n- [Project swarm ro
ll-up](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/project-swarm-roll-up.md): Recent runs with their goal-completion rate
s and repeat-failure findings, plus a project-wide trend. Deterministic and free. Start here.\n- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The deterministic rubric result for one run. N
o model, no spend.\n- [List swarm findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/list-swarm-findings.md): Criteria
that keep failing, tracked across waves. One finding is one problem OVER TIME: `occurrenceCount` and `status` carry the history,
so do not treat repeat appearances as separate problems.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insigh
ts/dismiss-a-finding.md): Hides a finding from your view. ORTHOGONAL to `status`: dismissing does not claim the problem stopped ha
ppening, and a dismissed finding that fires again stays `recurring`.\n- [Undismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/swarm-insights/undismiss-a-finding.md): Reverses a dismissal. Bodyless, like its twin.\n- [Get swarm run insights](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-swarm-run-insights.md): Poll this after requesting insights. **404 means nobody asked*
*: it is deliberately not an empty `status: \"none\"` body, so a caller in a polling loop cannot mistake \"never requested\" for \
"asked and still working\".\n- [Request swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/request-swarm-run
-insights.md): Answers **202**: generation is scheduled, not done. Poll the GET above rather than re-requesting.\n- [Cancel a pend
ing swarm-run-insights generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/cancel-a-pending-swarm-run-insights-genera
tion.md): Stops a generation that is still `pending`. A swarm run with no generation in progress answers 409: there is nothing to
cancel, and reporting success would tell a caller it stopped something it did not.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam.
Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insight
s.\n- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): *
*Spends.** Runs the goal-completion judge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.\n-
[Start a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-readin
ess-run.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. The tar
get comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Poll the
run detail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…\n- [Start an OpenAI plugin-directory readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-an-openai-plugin-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against OpenAI's pl
ugin-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. `submissionMode` is required and never inferred: inferring it would r
ead a forgotten package as `mcp-only` and report the package lane not-applicable, turning a missing input into a clean bill of…\n-
[Start a Muse connector readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-muse-connector-readiness
-run.md): Grades the saved server against Meta's Muse connector guidelines and returns `202` with a run id. Free: Muse readiness h
as no AI observations, so the body has no field that can spend, and no submission mode, which belongs to the OpenAI plugin directo
